name: 3can-runtimehook
description: Keep task intent and semantic review current across long Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep intent and semantic review current
interface.longDescription: An offline semantic supervisor for long Codex tasks. It restores Owner Intent after resume or compaction and reminds the Agent when goal, hardcoding, fallback, stale-state, or unrequested-behavior review is due.
